runtime_costs.original_controller_span_scope: original started to final updated, including development, waits, audits, interruptions and recovery gaps

important_scope: error means are conditional on available histories; missing outcome bounds retain full128
all same_action counts from summary use full128 while performance comparisons available88
paired pooled bootstrap is descriptive across available experimental-history mixture; no evaluation tuning
action_key difference means saved injection arrays differ bytewise; no claim on material curve norm
family costs include all four domains and share caches; they are not independent cold-run totals
line_known is conditional-variance ablation, not an oracle with true R/X
